# Pinoy Garden Cafe

> Filipino Food Truck in Bloomington, Indiana. Sisig, pancit, pork adobo tacos and ube rice cakes from a family that feels like home.

- Phone: (812) 287-9325
- Address: 2366 W Rappel Ave, Bloomington, IN 47404
- Areas: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Spencer, Nashville, Martinsville
- Offers: Sisig and savory plates; Pancit and skewers; Tacos and sweets
- Rating: 4.8 from 24 Google reviews
